**Element Layout (14.2 points):**
Balanced split-screen design. Text on the left complements animations on the right without crowding the frame.

**Attractiveness (13.5 points):**
Clean, modern minimalist style. High-contrast colors against a dark background effectively highlight geometric properties.

**Logic Flow (15.1 points):**
Strong pedagogical structure. Sequential progression from basic dimensions to complex 4D concepts ensures clear conceptual scaffolding.

**Accuracy & Depth (14.5 points):**
Rigorous content. Accurately demonstrates dimensional projection, slicing logic, and net unfolding with appropriate academic depth.

**Visual Consistency (13.8 points):**
Uniform visual language. Color coding and typography remain consistent throughout the presentation and animation phases.

**Overall Summary:**
A high-quality educational video that effectively uses visual aids to demystify complex dimensional geometry through logical progression.

**Key Strengths:**
• Logical dimensional scaffolding
• Effective color-coded visual cues

**Areas for Improvement:**
• Slightly slower pacing in complex segments
• Broader variety in 3D-to-2D examples

The length of the original line becomes the length of each side of the square and each edge of the cube, so this measurement does not change. The number of corners, number of sides (edges), and dimensionality all increase with each step.

B
The volume of a cube is calculated by cubing its side length (side × side × side). In this case, 4³ = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64 cubic units.

C
A cube's faces are squares. A slice made by a plane that is parallel to one of these faces will produce a cross-section with the same shape, which is a square.

B
The cat-shaped cookie cutter creates a 2D outline on the dough. Extruding this shape upwards adds a third dimension (height), transforming the flat 2D shape into a 3D object.

C
To determine if the dog can fit, you must compare its physical dimensions (its 3D shape) against the dimensions of the pipe's opening (its 2D cross-section). The other factors are not relevant to whether it can physically pass through.
